effect_description_eng:
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Trash your top security card and 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -13000 DP until their turn ends. Then, if you have 1 or fewer security cards, ＜Recovery +2 (Deck)＞ (Place the top 2 cards of your deck on top of your security stack.)
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When your security stack is removed from, trash your opponent's top security card.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When any of your [TS] trait Digimon or Tamers would leave the battle area, by trashing your top security card, they don't leave.
